name: dsh-pet-sprite
description: A playable pixel companion for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: hatch an egg and pick one of three companions (girl / tabby cat / baby whale), platform-jump over chat messages, WASD controllable, with a full nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop, inventory) fed by your agent's real token usage.

scripts.prepare: tsdown || echo 'build skipped: tsdown not available (lib/ is committed)'
